entry.author: Parliamentary Commissioner for the Environment
entry.summary:
The Parliamentary Commissioner for the Environment, Simon Upton and staff present the fifth annual Estimate of Environmental Expenditure. The PCE monitors how public funds are used for environmental outcomes and reports their findings to Parliament via the Environment Select Committee. 
Read the report here: https://pce.parliament.nz/publications/estimate-of-environmental-expenditure-202526-method-and-results/
